  • Before every job check the frame, the focus and that the bed is clear.

<h3>Taratura da foto del test: come si f:
Calibration from a test photo: how to do it

  1. Prepare the test. In Material test choose Fill and tick Markers for reading the photo: four small checkered squares will be engraved at the corners of the test, so FreeLaserCut can find the grid in the photo.
  2. Engrave the test on a piece of the same material you will use (Start the test). Don't change the values in the window after engraving it: they are needed to read the photo.
  3. Clean the surface with a dry cloth or a brush: smoke deposited between the squares skews the measurement.
  4. Take the photo from above, as straight as possible, with the whole test and the four small squares in the frame. Even light (near a window or with the room light), no shadow from the phone and no reflections. No flash needed.
  5. Pass the photo to FreeLaserCut: From a file (photo copied to the PC), From the camera (the laser camera, if it sees the test) or From the phone (Laser → Phone control, “Send the test photo” button).
  6. Check the result: each square shows how dark it is. Choose one of the suggested values with “Use this” and save it in the material library.

The measurement compares each square with the bare wood between the squares: it applies to that material and that light. It helps you choose; the last word goes to your eye.

Apre nel browser il sito di MakerHub, un: Opens the MakerHub site in the browser; MakerHub is an external service (maker-hub.it, an account is needed). There you choose one of their laser tools: Dima Lab (jigs to position your objects), Forma Lab (boxes, displays, organizers), Hinge Lab (flexible bands around a shape), Split Lab (projects larger than the bed, with joints). When the drawing is ready, press “Manda a FreeLaserCut” on the site: it arrives here on the work area, without downloading it; if there is more than one sheet, each goes on its own work plate. FreeLaserCut sends nothing to MakerHub: it opens the page and waits for the drawing on this computer.
Con la spunta FreeLaserCut aspetta i dis: When ticked, FreeLaserCut waits for the drawings sent by the “Manda a FreeLaserCut” button of the MakerHub tools. It turns on by itself the first time you open the MakerHub tools. It listens only on this computer, never on the network, and accepts drawings only from the MakerHub site; the laser never starts by itself and every drawing that arrives can be removed with Ctrl+Z. When not ticked, drawings are downloaded from the site and brought here with File → Import.
